mapper.select: SELECT esub.id, esub.student_id, esub.submission_date, u.name AS student_name, e.title AS exam_title FROM exam_submissions esub JOIN exams e ON esub.exam_id = e.id JOIN users u ON esub.student_id = u.id WHERE e.teacher_id = #{teacherId} ORDER BY esub.submission_date DESC LIMIT #{limit}
